hero.name: Lika Ninidze
hero.tagline: Five years of turning guest requests into seamless stays — front desks, tour groups, and booking systems all pass through my hands calmly. I've just completed a full web development track alongside that experience, and I'm now looking for my next role.

paragraphs: I studied Archaeology at Georgian Technical University, which turned out to be excellent training for hospitality: both reward patience, careful documentation, and the ability to reconstruct a whole story from a few details.

Since 2021 I've worked across operations, tourism, reservations, and front desk roles in Batumi and Tbilisi — coordinating bookings, guiding groups, and making sure guests feel looked after from the first email to the final checkout.
Alongside that, I'm building web development skills — HTML/CSS, JavaScript, and now React — with the same attention to detail I bring to a guest's reservation.
